name: EOL / Unsupported Tagging
summary: Charon — finds the assets running Unsupported or End-of-Life software (lifecycle text in the plugin name, so it expands as new EOL plugins appear) and tags them: Lifecycle:<Unsupported|End of Life> (navi tag-by-name) and by end-of-life date Lifecycle EOL:<YYYY-MM-DD>. Product view: OS vs application, years past end of life, crown jewels, KEV and critical overlap.
